rawDescription:
Appointment Required

Please call (408) 350-3288 on Monday-Friday between 8:00am - 5:00pm to set up a free one-on-one counseling appointment.

Space Available

Medicare Without Stress — Free, Unbiased Help

Confused about Medicare? You don't have to figure it out alone.

HICAP (Health Insurance Counseling and Advocacy Program) provides free, unbiased, and confidential counseling to help you understand your Medicare and Medi-Cal options. Our counselors do not sell insurance or recommend plans—we're here to help you make informed decisions.

HICAP offers free one-on-one appointments at Evergreen Branch Library.

Get Help With:

  • Medicare Enrollment
  • Original Medicare (Part A & B)
  • Medicare Advantage Plans (Part C)
  • Prescription Drug Coverage (Part D)
  • Supplemental Insurance (Medigap)
  • Limited Income Programs for Medicare
  • Medicare and Medi-Cal Options
  • Tips for Avoiding Medicare Fraud

Call (408) 350-3288 to schedule an appointment.

Book online: Click Here

ADA Accommodation Requests
